stable.notes: Connect your glasses in one scan: Setup guide > Glasses checks Tailscale on your Mac and iPhone, shows a pairing code for COS Glasses 6.10.621, and pairs after you tap Allow. When an update is ready the menu-bar glasses turn gold with an Update available banner. Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. Pairs with server 6.67.0.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
